mapper.select: SELECT * FROM srv_service_issue WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND task_id=#{query.taskId} AND deleted=b'0' ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT i.*,t.project_id FROM srv_service_issue i JOIN srv_inspection_task t ON t.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND t.id=i.task_id WHERE i.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND i.deleted=b'0' AND t.deleted=b'0'
AND t.project_id IN #{id}
AND 1=0
ORDER BY t.project_id,i.task_id,i.id
